info.title: Afridict Backend API
info.description: Identity, governance and financial workflow API. Financial commands execute only in the isolated synthetic demo; no real payment partner, chain indexer, custody activation, trading or resolution is available. Production access requires approved adapters and governance.

bearerAuth.description: OIDC access token verified against configured issuer, audience and JWKS. Roles come from server-owned account records. Demo mode accepts only synthetic demo.<persona> selectors; those never work in production.

ApiError.description: Error response. A network timeout does not imply that a command failed. Retry a command using its original idempotency key and body.

code.description: Stable error code; branch on this field, not message. Unknown codes must be handled safely.

message.description: Safe explanation without provider payloads, identity evidence, or stack traces.

request_id.description: Server-issued correlation identifier. Also returned in X-Request-Id.

jurisdiction.description: Country code. ZZ is reserved for the isolated synthetic demo.

policy_version.description: Version of the applied eligibility policy.

trading_enabled.description: False in this release: execution and real-money activation are not implemented.

Capabilities.description: Server-owned action decisions. The UI may explain requirements but must not use them to bypass backend enforcement.

AuthenticationConfiguration.description: Public, non-secret authentication discovery. Google and password authentication are owned by one configured OIDC provider so Afridict does not create competing identities.

RegistrationProfile.description: Account-owned registration profile. Password credentials remain exclusively with the configured identity provider.

ContactVerification.description: Normalized contact possession workflow. OTP values and provider credentials are never persisted or returned.

IdentityStatus.description: Afridict-normalized identity state. Persona remains the external identity-document authority; raw documents are never returned.

client_token.description: Short-lived Persona client token for the authenticated account only.

MarketTerms.description: Versioned public market policy. Binary requires yes/no outcomes; scalar requires short/long and scalar_range; categorical requires unique outcomes. Publication fixes the complete policy hash. No endpoint in this release activates trading.

question.description: Precise public question. Do not include private or identifying information.

unit.description: Unit for the scaled scalar observation.

items.description: Country code. ZZ is reserved for the isolated synthetic demo.

timezone.description: IANA timezone used to interpret evidence.

uri.description: Evidence-source reference. This API never fetches supplied URLs.
Evidence-source reference. This API never fetches supplied URLs.

correction_rule.description: Handling of revisions and corrected results.

invalid_rule.description: Exact invalid-market conditions and reference to the approved payout policy.

adjudicator_policy_ref.description: Approved conflict, recusal, quorum and adjudication policy reference.

bond_policy_ref.description: Approved proposal/challenge bond and slashing policy reference.

payout_policy_ref.description: Approved payout policy including invalid outcomes and rounding.

eligibility_policy_ref.description: Jurisdiction and participant eligibility policy reference.

settlement_asset_ref.description: Collateral registry reference; this API does not select or approve a token.

examples.question: Synthetic binary demonstration: what rainfall result will the example station report?

resolution.criteria: Synthetic policy only: use the named daily rainfall edition and the selected outcome boundaries.
